articles.title: 2 San Antonio billionaires are the richest people in America, Forbes says - CultureMap San Antonio
articles.description: The richest billionaires in America have a collective worth of $8 trillion in 2026, a staggering $1.4 trillion increase since last year, says Forbes. And two members of San Antonio's H-E-B family are among the richest in the nation.
